scope: Expanded web research. No images deployed, no subscriptions/accounts created and no providers contacted.
limits: Bounded Commons queries retain continuation markers; not an exhaustive Commons inventory.
Do not add these asset counts to the 205-movement wger count; assets overlap and some are excluded.
Provider library counts are advertised totals and do not establish exact FORMA movement coverage.
Static images cannot verify complete exercise execution.

providers.name: YMove
providers.status: Strong candidate for licensed consistent media; actual FORMA coverage not audited
providers.rights: Free set of 25 clips; larger API/subscription licences. Terms and pricing include brand registration, time-limited URLs, subscription-only rights and separate self-hosting permission. Product pages and terms differ on brand/white-label entitlements; obtain exact plan agreement.

providers.name: Hyperhuman
providers.status: App/web/API licensing offered, individual catalogue access and rights depend on plan
providers.rights: Commercial agreement defines channels, territory and provider scope; still extraction/rehosting must be included.

providers.name: WorkoutDB
providers.status: Additional photo/API provider; exact matches unverified
providers.rights: Page states commercial media use on Pro/Scale; free tier noncommercial with attribution. Full licence/storage rights not verified.

providers.name: Physitrack
providers.type: Professionally filmed clinical, conditioning and machine exercises
providers.status: Useful catalogue lead, not an unrestricted image source
providers.rights: Current service terms restrict copying/commercial redistribution outside granted scope. Separate agreement needed for FORMA.

providers.name: Pexels
providers.status: License page retrieved; exercise search pages HTTP 403; no exact-variation candidates approved
providers.rights: Free use and modification, attribution optional; no implied endorsement or redistribution as a stock service.

providers.name: GymVisual
providers.status: Home retrieved; actual terms HTTP 403. Not counted as real-photo coverage
providers.rights: Old /content/6 terms URL now redirects to Price rules; actual terms link is /content/3-terms-and-conditions-of-use.

providers.name: WorkoutLabs
providers.status: Licensing page retrieved; alternative illustration style, not real photos
providers.rights: Case-specific commercial illustration licence. Advertised full-library starting prices are $1,200/year or $3,500+ perpetual; not purchased.

providers.name: ExRx
providers.status: Homepage retrieved; actual legal page HTTP 403; reuse terms unresolved
providers.rights: No permission to copy inferred from public access.

providers.name: Life Fitness
providers.status: Fetched page is Commercial Terms and Conditions of Sale, not a media reuse licence
providers.rights: Equipment identity references do not confer publication permission for product photos.

commonsCandidates.descriptionHtml: From front left, U.S. Army Maj. Roger Miranda and Capt. Edward McDonald, both with the 1st Cavalry Division, and 2nd Lt. Wesley Gordon with the 1st Air Cavalry Brigade, exercise using pull-up bars during the CrossFit Open competition at Fort Hood, Texas, April 5, 2013.

commonsCandidates.title: File:Plank.jpg
commonsCandidates.descriptionHtml: Planks activate and strengthen the inner core muscles as well as rectus abdominis and transverse abdominis. Planks help stabilize your spine and hips. Performing this exercise can help prevent back injury and back pain.

visualReview.finding: Straight-arm high plank. Excluded for the forearm-plank guide; high-plank candidate only.

visualReview.finding: Seated horizontal leg-press photo, cropped to legs and apparatus. Suitable for apparatus recognition; does not show supported back or full technique.
